test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. Rohan verbally insulted Stephen in front of his parents.**

options.text: Stephen was verbally being insulted by Rohan in front of his parents.
Stephen has verbally insulted by Rohan in front of his parents.
Stephen was verbally insulted by Rohan in front of his parents.
Stephen had been verbally insulted by Rohan in front of his parents.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Stephen was verbally insulted by Rohan in front of his parents.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The verb '**insulted**' is changed to '**was insulted**' in passive voice.
